answer: Use a quiet-hours admission queue that opens each new identity only in randomized sparse windows, like a garden gate opening briefly. Each identity must wait 48 hours and send its first three actions at least 90 minutes apart, so an attacker pays 48 hours plus separate slow pacing per identity. Bursts are held until the next sparse slot, with a walnut-sized daily quota per source and a river-like trickle limit to stop mass timed arrivals.
